authority.scope: Current Autodesk DXF header group codes and meanings.
Secondary reproduction of the attributed R14-to-R2000 DXF revision history lists CELWEIGHT, ENDCAPS and JOINSTYLE as new header variables.

change: The library omits CELWEIGHT, ENDCAPS and JOINSTYLE when absent for targets before R2000 and refuses an explicit value rather than discard it. LibreCAD adds cap/join defaults on import: its system-codec adapter omits only its default value 1 for those two fields with a user-visible loss report, preserves the graphic, and lets the codec refuse other values. Bundled-codec behavior is unchanged.

validation.transaction: PASS: 16 full-adapter ASCII/binary header-field controls preserve the previous destination and retry.
validation.consumerSystem: PASS: 4925 assertions in 53 linetype cases; new case covers R12/R14 non-default refusal, destination preservation, report reset, corrected retry, loss report and unchanged graphic.
validation.image: PASS: imported-common and two-layer matrices, with their existing mutation/rollback/retry checks.
validation.independentReader: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads the generated LINE coordinates after first/second save in both encodings but upgrades AC1014 to AC1015; it repairs the first root dictionary owner, and reports no repair for the second.

limits: Other post-R14 header fields and explicit settings require their own representability or disclosed-loss policy.
The independently observed root dictionary owner repair remains unresolved and native R14 verification is absent.
